headword: {行政機関|ぎょうせいきかん}

definitions.explanation: An organ of the executive branch that carries out public administration — a ministry, an agency, or a local government office. Contrasted with the legislature and the courts.

examples.japanese: {行政機関|ぎょうせいきかん}に{届|とど}け{出|で}る。
examples.english: To file a notification with an administrative agency.

examples.japanese: この{制度|せいど}は{複数|ふくすう}の{行政機関|ぎょうせいきかん}が{関|かか}わっている。
examples.english: Several administrative agencies are involved in this system.

examples.japanese: {行政機関|ぎょうせいきかん}が{持|も}つ{情報|じょうほう}は、{原則|げんそく}として{公開|こうかい}を{請求|せいきゅう}することができる。
examples.english: As a rule, one can request disclosure of information held by administrative agencies.

notes:
{行政|ぎょうせい} (administration, the executive) + {機関|きかん} (organ, institution). A term of law and public administration, common in official documents and news.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国|くに}の{行政機関|ぎょうせいきかん}: national administrative agencies
- {行政機関|ぎょうせいきかん}の{長|ちょう}: the head of an agency
- {行政機関|ぎょうせいきかん}に{申請|しんせい}する: to apply to an administrative agency

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {役所|やくしょ}: government office — the everyday word for the building or counter one visits
- {官庁|かんちょう}: government ministries and agencies — refers to national-level bodies collectively
- {自治体|じちたい}: local government — a prefecture or municipality as a unit
